title: Palm Beach vs. Miami Bridal Makeup Styles: Which Is Right for You?
excerpt: Discover how Palm Beach's timeless elegance and Miami's bold glamour inspire two distinct bridal makeup aesthetics for Florida brides.
content: Palm Beach brides tend to favor refined, sun-kissed looks with soft peach tones, barely-there liners, and luminous skin that feels effortlessly chic. Miami brides, on the other hand, embrace dramatic definition — think sculpted contour, rich lip colors, and bold lashes that command the dance floor. At Velora Bella, we help you identify which aesthetic resonates with your wedding vision and craft a personalized look that feels authentically you.

title: Soft Glam vs Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam can feel overwhelming, but the right look is simply the one that makes you feel most like yourself.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, blended neutrals, and a natural radiance that photographs beautifully in Florida's golden outdoor light. Full glam, on the other hand, delivers bold lashes, defined contour, and rich color that commands attention in grand ballroom settings. At Velora Bella, we help every bride discover her perfect balance by considering venue, lighting, and personal style during a customized consultation.
